description: List the files and directories directly inside a directory of the installed plugin's file tree (the project's own plugin copy), or the root without `path`. `pluginId` targets another plugin of the project instead of the installed one. Returns an array ({items} in structuredContent).

path.description: Directory path, e.g. "settings"; root if omitted.

pluginId.description: Id of the plugin to act on (see plugins_list); the installed plugin if omitted (CLI: --plugin-id).

name: plugins_files_list
title: List plugin files
